thesis: The podcast introduces Ash Williams, the executive director and chief investment officer of the Florida State Board of Administration, who oversees $200 billion in assets for the state of Florida. The conversation covers his career history, including his early experience in the Florida legislature, his time on Wall Street, and his return to manage the state's assets after the global financial crisis.
